title: BAFA (Block Aim-assist For Accesibility)
description: Aim Assist for blocks made for accesibility. mostly for mining
body:
# BAFA Is
A block aim assist made for accesibility to help with mining/breaking and placing blocks
it features many adjustments for any parameter u can think of and has both a keybind and options for only working when holding a mouse button or when holding the crouch key.
its also possible to make it filter wat blocks it should aim for even with a place for custom entries
the project adds
- a keybind to turn on and off the block aim assist
> - There is also a menu button on off in the mod menu menu
- a settings menu with mod menu and cloth config installed
> - This includes for parameters on for an example how fast the aim assist should move. If it should continue to aim for the center or if being in the outlined area on the block face is enough. A visualizer showing wat the aim assist is aiming for. there are also parameters for max block distance to snap to. An FOV Field to make it only work at wat u are looking at for an example. Adjustments on interpolation and humanization with accel and friction adjusting on on interpolation and a jitter and speed field for the humanization. "Aim for center" that continues aiming for the center of the block even if the deadzone is reached. A stop deadzone that stops the aim assist once inide the area on the block face. the vizualizer can also be turned on and off. There is also an aim targets section where u can specify wat blocks its should aim for with a custom block entries section at the bottom where u can add and remove entries

Things maybe in the future:
- Weights that determine wat blocks are more important than others for the blocks in the aim targets section

This mod is made for accesibility or help with aiming at blocks if thats something ur having trouble with this mod will be a good fit for u. Ty for downloading - sacdj
